annotations.title: Get product picks for a color season

description: BeautySpark's top product pick per category (blush, highlighter, eyeliner, lipstick, lip gloss, bronzer, eyeshadow palette) for a color season, each with the reason and the article it comes from.

category.description: Only return picks of this category.

locale.description: The user's language as a language tag, e.g. "de" or "pt-BR". Set it from the user's language. Defaults to English.

season.description: Color season, e.g. "True Winter" or "true_winter". One of the 12 seasons.
